summary: hand-held weapon built from its side profile: receiver, barrel, grip and the separate pieces that touch it, a muzzle flash and a soft photo texture; hero adds rails, sights and controls as geometry.

overall.summary: the whole weapon, side both ways and 3/4

receiver.summary: receiver, slide or bolt, ejection port

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.

items.name: Receiver or body
items.construction: the side outline extruded, then rounded where the hand goes; never a stretched box

items.name: Barrel
items.construction: mesh.lathe tube with an open dark muzzle

items.name: Grip
items.construction: pistol grip or handle rounded for the hand

items.name: Trigger and guard
items.construction: trigger blade inside a guard loop

items.name: Magazine
items.construction: magazine pushed into the well (waive for melee or a tube-fed gun)

items.name: Muzzle flash
items.construction: crossed planes on the flash texture at the muzzle (gunflash frame; waive for melee)

items.name: Photo texture
items.construction: small soft photo texture on both sides

items.name: Stock
items.construction: stock lofted from the profile with a buttplate (waive for a pistol)

items.name: Sights
items.construction: front post and rear notch as separate small pieces

items.name: Slide or bolt
items.construction: slide or bolt as its own piece with serrations and an ejection port

items.name: Rails
items.construction: rail strips swept from a toothed profile

items.name: Optic or scope
items.construction: scope tube with lenses on mounts

items.name: Controls
items.construction: safety, mag release, charging handle, selector

views_note: views name the close-up regions of 'blender preview --regions' (data/kit/regions/weapon.json) that show each region; 'overall' with no views = the standard preview sheet
